title: Isolate Dolt command execution and checkpoint repository responsibilities
description:
DoltRepo currently handles shell execution, SQL assembly, repository initialization, commit/log/read/branch behavior, and checkpoint persistence concerns together.

Split lower-level Dolt command execution and SQL encoding from checkpoint repository behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- Dolt command execution is isolated.
- Dolt SQL/string encoding is isolated or made safer.
- Checkpoint repository behavior is easier to test.
- Existing checkpoint tests pass.
- No change to user-facing checkpoint behavior.
close_reason: Split DoltRepo into DoltCli (low-level CLI: run/query/init/commit/branch) + DoltRepo (campaign_snapshot schema + HEX round-tripping). sqlLiteral exported with regression-guarded unit tests. Public DoltRepo surface unchanged. PR #88.
